items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And then from -- after meeting Frankie Trumbauer, he played in the summer time at a place called West Lake, and Ted Jansen, Pee Wee, and I don't know, a gang of musicians were playing.

ctx.x: And he heard about Charlie, and he came to hear the band, and he was playing at the place called -- well, he was at the Arcadia, and he told a man -- it was a place just like Roseland, a beautiful ballroom. Never thought of hiring a black band but Frankie Trumbauer wanted this boss to have Charlie to come in there for one night, see. And I'll never forget, because I had to buy a gown, oh, and they bought tuxedos, the band dressed up in tuxedos. We were sharp when we went there and broke it up. And from then on,…
He was a good drummer he had drummer
